Test station: PCB TestKit catalog station 1

One station, 118 board types: every fixture is the station's 300 x 220 mm plate with the mating connector J1 in the same place, so swapping a fixture is all it takes to test another board. Generated by PCB TestKit 1.1.2 from station-1.kicad_pcb.

Swapping to another board type

  1. Switch the station's supplies off and unscrew the fixture.
  2. Plug the next board type's fixture onto connector J1 + J2 and screw it down in the same holes.
  3. Run that board's runner (its folder below): its testplan.json knows which station pins its boards use.
  4. Every board has its own nest and toggle clamp on the fixture: slide a board into each nest up to the stop (above the pogo pins), close its clamp, and the runner tests the boards one by one; open a clamp to take that board off. usb_dongle_11: from the left.
